description: This file defines data structures, function prototypes, and mechanisms for thread-local counters used in the Trace2 profiling system. It includes counter management, metadata, and functions for incrementing, updating, and emitting counters, focusing on efficient, lock-free thread-local counter accumulation.

methods.name: tr2_counter_increment
methods.description: Increments the specified counter for the current thread by a given value.

methods.name: tr2_update_final_counters
methods.description: Aggregates thread-local counters into global totals during thread exit.

methods.name: tr2_emit_per_thread_counters
methods.description: Emits the counter data for the current thread.

methods.name: tr2_emit_final_counters
methods.description: Emits the final global counter values at program exit.
